project_info.theme: White sequin red-carpet goddess portrait with warm golden bokeh

main_subject.detail: Clearly adult woman with dark brown hair in a sleek textured ponytail, hazel expressive eyes, clean natural makeup, champagne shimmer, soft winged eyeliner, peach blush and glossy muted-pink lips. She wears a high-neck sleeveless white gown densely covered in reflective silver and gold sequins and crystals with intricate beadwork, delicate diamond drop earrings and a diamond tennis bracelet. Her left hand is raised near her temple and her head tilts slightly in an elegant poised gesture.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic professional red-carpet portrait of a generic clearly adult woman with hazel expressive eyes and dark brown hair in an elegant textured ponytail, sleek at the top with wispy strands framing the face. Use natural clean-girl makeup with champagne shimmer eyeshadow, soft winged eyeliner, groomed brows, luminous dewy skin, soft peach blush and glossy muted-pink lips. She wears a high-neck sleeveless white gown densely embellished with reflective silver and gold sequins and crystals in an intricate beadwork pattern, delicate diamond drop earrings and a matching diamond tennis bracelet. Pose her with the left hand near the temple and head tilted slightly in an elegant poised gesture. Set the scene in a soft-focus luxury gala environment with cream vertical pleated curtains and warm golden abstract signage or letters. Use soft warm glamorous event lighting, golden bokeh, professional DSLR photography, shallow depth of field, sharp subject focus, clean highlights and 8K resolution. Preserve the source gown, makeup, jewelry, pose and warm gala atmosphere without reproducing Ana de Armas or any public-figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, readable logo, signature, distorted signage
